fields.label: Capacity Provisioning Type
fields.help: Provisioning type of the byte capacity of the pool.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the StoragePool.

fields.label: Performance Provisioning Type
fields.help: Provisioning type of the performance-related parameters of the pool, such as throughput and IOPS.

fields.label: Pool Provisioned Capacity Gb
fields.help: Size, in GiB, of the storage pool.

fields.label: Pool Provisioned Iops
fields.help: Provisioned IOPS of the storage pool.

fields.label: Pool Provisioned Throughput
fields.help: Provisioned throughput, in MB/s, of the storage pool.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: A reference to the zone where the storage pool resides.

fields.label: Params
fields.help: Additional params passed with the request, but not persisted as part of resource payload
